Mavericks @ Timberwolves 6/10 7:00 - Flagg's Mavs test short-handed Wolves
Pistons @ Wizards 4/10 6:00 - Young teams, but Detroit favored big
Raptors @ 76ers 3/10 6:00 - Depleted Toronto on a back-to-back

games.notes: Edwards and DiVincenzo out for Minnesota, Lively out for Dallas. Flagg's Mavs get a real shot at a short-handed Wolves team; should be competitive.
Duren out for Detroit. Two young teams, but Washington is on a back-to-back and the Pistons are the clear better side; likely a comfortable Detroit win.
Barnes and Kawhi out for Toronto, LeBron out and Embiid questionable for Philly. Raptors are on a back-to-back and thin; likely a Sixers win.
Knueppel, Brandon Miller and Schroder out for Charlotte, Mark Williams out for Phoenix. Two bad teams missing key guys; easy skip.
